title: DONE is undefined
scenario: A task says 'make this better' with no acceptance criterion, intended outcome or evidence-backed interpretation that is low-risk and testable.
oracle: Do not proceed as though DONE were defined; stop or surface CONFLICT until a testable completion condition is established.
must_detect: multiple unsupported interpretations cannot be silently chosen
must_not: invent a preferred objective and proceed
why_exists: Carries forward the governance suite's unclear-requirement case into the canonical catalog.
stale_when: If the scenario is amended with a testable DONE or one clearly supported interpretation.

title: Large clear task should decompose
scenario: A clear task requires coordinated changes across dozens of independent modules with separate owners and test surfaces. The objective is valid but too large to verify safely as one unit.
oracle: Use DECOMPOSE into bounded, owned, testable slices rather than pretending the whole task is tractable or escalating a nonexistent design conflict.
must_detect: scope is too large but clear
must_not: treat size alone as design conflict
why_exists: Carries forward the governance suite's large repo-wide change case.
stale_when: If the task becomes genuinely small/tractable or a real authority/design conflict is introduced.

title: Architecture tradeoff has unclear owner
scenario: Two architecture options are both feasible and protect different values, but the accountable owner and governing source of truth for the tradeoff cannot be established.
oracle: Do not choose by reviewer preference. Surface CONFLICT with the tradeoff, missing owner/authority and evidence needed for accountable judgment.
must_not: silently select the reviewer's favorite architecture
why_exists: Carries forward the governance suite's unclear-owner architecture case.
stale_when: If an accountable owner and governing decision rule are supplied.

title: Failure can be silently accepted
scenario: A batch job catches all exceptions, records no failure signal, returns success and lets downstream automation continue as though processing completed.
oracle: Identify silent failure and require a visible failure signal or a conflict if safe signaling cannot be established.
must_detect: failure is hidden while success is reported
downstream state can be silently invalid
must_not: approve because the process does not crash
why_exists: Carries forward the governance suite's silent-failure case as a concrete scenario.
stale_when: If failures are surfaced reliably and downstream success cannot be falsely asserted.

title: Repeated local fixes reveal one structural category
scenario: Three recent fixes independently repair the same class of state-sync defect in adjacent modules, and the same local pattern is appearing again.
oracle: Trigger DOUBLE-LOOP review of the rule/design/detection mechanism instead of treating the repeated category as another isolated local fix forever.
must_not: apply another local fix without examining recurrence
declare a systemic bug without evidence
why_exists: Carries forward the governance suite's repeated-local-fixes learning case.
stale_when: If the prior fixes are shown unrelated categories rather than the same repeating mechanism.

title: API interface change must account for consumers and migration
scenario: A shared API field is renamed in the producer. Several consumers still use the old field and no migration or compatibility period is specified.
oracle: Treat the producer-only patch as incomplete: inspect the contract and consumers, establish migration/compatibility handling and verify end-to-end behavior.
must_not: expand into unrelated modules beyond consumers/interfaces
why_exists: Carries forward the governance suite's API/interface full-flow obligation in concrete form.
stale_when: If all consumers have migrated or an authoritative compatibility contract covers the transition.
